thread:
Maria Chen: Hey team — PM ask: can we surface per-customer noisy-neighbor signals and a simple per-org dashboard in Console? need tradeoffs + infra inputs. cc @Samir @Elaine
Samir Patel: +1, we need metrics from runtime (queue depth, KV cache hit rate, throttles) and infra (gpu util, node preemption).
Elaine Ortiz: agree. also need cost attribution by org (tokens, outbound network). otherwise teams will misinterpret noise as cost spikes.
Devon Brooks: quick list from runtime side: `per_org_qps`, `per_org_queued`, `per_org_avg_latency_p50_p90`, `kv_cache_hit_ratio`, `failed_allocs_by_org`. we can emit as statsd -> ingest.
Kai Nakamura: important: make sure per-org keys are hashed in telemetry to avoid PII. we can send `org_id_hash` plus sampling for high-card orgs.
Liz Carter: UX ask: product wants a 1-click "isolate org" button to view only that tenant's timeline and a suggested mitigation (throttle/capacity bump). also role-based access.
Samir Patel: technical caveat: some signals need to be derived in the aggregator (like noisy neighbor score). propose a 3-tier signal: raw metrics, normalized (per-req), and composite "noise_index" (0-100).
Maria Chen: what's the formula for noise_index? can we make it explainable?
Devon Brooks: simple first pass: noise_index = normalize(queue_growth, latency_90_delta, cpu_spike, cache_drop) and weight by recentness. pseudocode:
```
noise_index = 0.4*scaled(queue_growth) + 0.3*scaled(lat90_delta) + 0.2*scaled(gpu_spike) + 0.1*(1 - cache_hit)
```
Samir Patel: we'll need to tune weights per model family. different models have different baseline latency variance.
Elaine Ortiz: also ensure we can attribute noisy requests to routes (routing policy) — need `route_id` in telemetry. that helps decide fallback policies (route -> cheaper model).
Maria Chen: good point. product would like an annotation on the dashboard showing current routing policy and last fallback event.
Kai Nakamura: data privacy: if org wants private deployment we shouldn't send metrics to hosted workspace. add `deployment_type` tag (hosted/dedicated/private) and avoid exporting private ones to central UI unless opt-in.
Liz Carter: for rollout UX: we should A/B the dashboard to a small set of internal accounts first. show a "report an incorrect noise flag" flow that kicks off an automated eval.
Devon Brooks: infra note: cardinality risk — per-org x per-route x per-model time series explodes. propose: emit per-org aggregates at 1m, and keep raw per-route only for top N orgs or sampled traces.
Samir Patel: agreed. can we use a heatmap ingestion for large customers and histograms for small ones?
Maria Chen: what about quotas? product wants to link quota config to dashboard so support can flip soft limits.
Elaine Ortiz: we already store quota config in ConfigDB. Add `quota_enforced` and `quota_window` tags to metrics so the Console shows both real-time usage and configured threshold.
Kai Nakamura: here's an API snippet for telemetry event we can standardize: 
```
POST /telemetry/v1/orgs/{org_id_hash}/metrics
{
  "timestamp": 1670000000,
  "org_id_hash": "sha256:xxx",
  "route_id": "chat:v1",
  "model_family": "redwood-13b",
  "metrics": {
    "qps": 12.3,
    "queued": 4,
    "lat_p50": 120,
    "lat_p90": 430,
    "kv_cache_hit": 0.82
  },
  "deployment_type": "hosted"
}
```
Samir Patel: that looks fine. add `sample_rate` and `ingest_version` to support evolving contract.
Devon Brooks: ingest pipeline changes: we need a lightweight processor to compute noise_index and store aggregated time series in TSDB and detailed events in long-term object store for 72h.
Liz Carter: support/business want exportable PDF for an org report including "noisy neighbor incidents" and suggested mitigations. estimate complexity?
Devon Brooks: basic PDF from dashboard snapshots is easy. automated incident summary generation (root cause hints) needs the eval pipeline — medium effort.
Elaine Ortiz: security question: Ought we block org-level dashboards for shared accounts with multiple teams? RBAC mapping must come from Identity service.
Maria Chen: action items: 1) runtime: emit agreed metrics + route_id + org_id_hash (Devon) 2) ingest: compute noise_index and maintain per-org aggregates, sample detailed traces for top N (Samir) 3) console: per-org dashboard wire + RBAC + export (Liz) 4) product: define initial noise_index weights and mitigation suggestions (Maria/Liz) 5) privacy: don't show private deployment metrics in hosted UI by default (Kai)
Samir Patel: timeline? I can get a PR for ingest changes in 2 weeks, Devon can add metric tags in next runtime sprint.
Devon Brooks: correct — runtime PR by EOD next Tues for metric names.
Liz Carter: I'll draft wireframes this week and do a quick internal test with 5 accounts.
Maria Chen: thanks all. please add follow-ups in this thread. I'll consolidate into a mini-spec for eng-platform docs. :rocket:
observability-bot: incident-digest created: "noisy-neighbor-pipeline-epic" -> https://boards.redwood.internal/INFR-332
Samir Patel: linking proposed TSDB schema here: `per_org.metrics.{qps,lat_p50,lat_p90,queued,cache_hit}` and `per_org.events.noise_alerts`
Elaine Ortiz: one last ask — make noise_alerts include `top_suspected_route` and `suspected_model` fields so support has quick context.
Maria Chen: noted. end of thread.
